title: Digital surfaces and thicknesses of selected hydrogeologic units of the Floridan aquifer system in Florida and parts of Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina
citation: Williams, L.J., and Dixon, J.F., 2015, Digital surfaces and thicknesses of selected hydrogeologic units of the Floridan aquifer system in Florida and parts of Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Data Series DS-926, map scale 1:5,208,000.
notes: Data Series 926 documents the GIS dataset (rasters, contours, points) for the revised Floridan aquifer system framework (Williams and Kuniansky, 2015). It prints no map surfaces or well values; the geodatabase layer tables (appendix table 1-1, tables 2-6) and interpolation residual statistics (table 1) were not recorded as geologic values. Vertical datum NGVD 29 (p. 7). References duplicate Professional Paper 1807 and were not repeated.
